subject: Procurement PR guidance & supplier linkage (Coupa/Ariba) - Next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme.com>
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai, laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick sync — procurement next steps and PR path

Hi Alex — great to speak earlier. Thanks for walking through Acme's use case and timeline.

Recap & suggested next steps: 
- Procurement path options we discussed: PR (PO via Coupa or Ariba), card payment (for smaller pilots), or via cloud marketplace (if you prefer subscription through AWS/GCP marketplace).
- For PR/PO route we typically provide: vendor information packet, supplier onboarding instructions (Coupa/Ariba), and a one-page purchase guidance for your procurement team (attached).
- Action items for Acme: confirm preferred commercial path (PO vs card vs marketplace) and whether procurement will create the PR/supplier or needs Redwood to be added as a supplier. If PO via Coupa/Ariba, let us know if you need our supplier ID or any specific vendor fields.
- We attached an Acme_PR_Template.xlsx you can use to create the internal PR and a short Redwood_Coupa_Instructions.pdf with common field mappings.

A couple of notes on timelines: once supplier setup is complete in Coupa/Ariba, onboarding to dedicated capacity typically takes ~5 business days (assuming security/commercial paperwork already agreed). If you go via marketplace it can sometimes be faster but may require a different billing arrangement.

If it helps, I can loop in our finance/ops team to confirm Redwood's supplier ID and open an internal ticket to support your procurement team.

Next step: can you confirm (1) selected payment path and (2) whether procurement will create the PR or if you need Redwood to be created as a supplier?

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0189
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Acme_PR_Template.xlsx (spreadsheet), Redwood_Coupa_Instructions.pdf (pdf)

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@acme.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 12:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick sync — procurement next steps and PR path

Hi Marissa — thanks for the clear recap.

Short answers: 
- Commercial path: PO via Coupa is our preference for SG2 pilot and initial contract.
- Procurement will create the PR, but we need your vendor details and supplier ID to link the line items.
- We also want the quote (final pricing + term) in PDF format to attach to the PR.

Can you send over a vendor pack with EIN, payment terms, remittance address, and supplier ID? If Redwood is already in Coupa or Ariba under a supplier ID we can reference, please share that.

I attached our internal procurement checklist (not included here) — Procurement will start the PR once we have the quote + vendor details. Thanks.

Best,
Alex Johnson
Head of Data Platform | Acme Corp
alex.johnson@acme.com | +1 212-555-0199
